artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan covering both axes: line_count auto-repair wired pre-deploy into deploy-headless.sh (reported, never silent), and the inter-cycle redeploy checkpoint rewired onto the (a)/(b)/(c) baseline contract via a new shared scripts/lib/deploy-baseline-lib.sh sourced by both call sites.

memory_candidates.content: Doc-vs-code contract drift in this codebase is undetected by any gate: batch-orchestration-guardrails.md documented the redeploy checkpoint's three-branch (a)/(b)/(c) failure contract, command-gate-out.sh implemented it correctly, and orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's checkpoint implemented only two of the three branches -- for a long time, with the doc asserting both sites matched. When a pattern file claims to be 'the single authoritative statement' of a contract with multiple implementing call sites, verify each call site against it rather than trusting the claim; the durable fix is extracting the contract into one sourced scripts/lib/*.sh anchor (the deploy-freshness-lib.sh / phase-heading-patterns.sh idiom) so a second site cannot re-diverge.
